objective: Under an exact literal axiom projection, convert every finite DAG-like semantic parity-resolution refutation, tracking line count, resolution depth, all shared references, and explicit bit work.
status: Proved: Every S-line DAG refutation in parity resolution with one-premise semantic weakening projects to a checked source refutation using at most S lines and no more resolution depth. Conversion costs polynomial work in the supplied encoding.
title: Transporting a complete parity-resolution proof over exact clause images
